headline: Players who know the world now love it (Maya and Priya 8, both finished with a full reveal), and realism rose most. Newcomers fell back: the auto-opening briefing at Guide me and too many words before the first choice cost Olivia and Noah (5). Trust is the other drag: status words that contradict outcomes (FAILED on things that happened, a loss called a step forward) and wild moves without real consequences.

loved.what: Playing a real crisis to a full reveal with a grade, seals and the truth table
Clear month: one move, cards with sizes, the result card
Realistic content: real talks, real leaders, era-correct worlds

patterns.title: Newcomers drown before the first choice
patterns.detail: The briefing auto-opens at Guide me and covers half the screen; the month-1 text wall; Noah never learned the one goal he was judged on.

patterns.title: Words that contradict what happened
patterns.detail: FAILED stamped on a staff meeting whose effects applied and on a vote the player cast; a -9 labelled A step forward; the result headline repeats a war move as 'your choice'.

patterns.title: Wild moves without consequences
patterns.detail: A nuclear strike on China drew only a denunciation and raised approval; the share card is a plain clipped text box.

patterns.title: Staff spend my capital for me
patterns.detail: Staff pre-spend political capital; show what each staff pick changes before Approve.

patterns.title: Map and desk still differ
patterns.detail: Map and desk order cards behave differently; the Desk button did not respond with a map menu open (Sam's quit point).

patterns.title: Replay and saves
patterns.detail: No discoverable way to replay a seed or branch from a month outside the reveal; an earlier game missing from Saved games.

patterns.title: Let me play the war I chose
patterns.detail: One Term opens on a random crisis; Ruth wanted Ukraine and plain words on what her Ukraine move did.

patterns.title: Recycled and misattributed lines
patterns.detail: Recycled Trump quotes, Russian state TV saying 'they blinked', 'Court Belarus' suggested to Ukraine.

surprises: The two most knowledgeable casual players rose the most (Maya 7 to 8, Priya 6 to 8).
A learning aid hurt the very newcomers it was built for, because it opened by itself.
Marcus reached the floor (5 to 6) thanks to plausible eras, but replay remains his wish.
environment: The build under test had a merge accident (conflict markers in benchmark files): the reveal showed no rarity and no ranking ladder in this round, which affects endings judged by Olivia, Noah, Maya, Leo and Sam. Fixed before push (D-57).
